title: 2024, Bluffdale City Planning Commission Meeting Agenda 03-20-2024

votes.motion: Commissioner Flynn moved to forward a POSITIVE recommendation to the City Council on the Proposed Text Amendment to Bluffdale City Land Use Regulation Section 6.20.020(D)(1), Application 2024-12), with the following finding: 1, That language be added to allow exceptions when written permission has been given. The motion was seconded by Commissioner Griffis
